authoring_policy: Requests state only observable frequency, accuracy, duty cycle, startup, supply, output-level, loading, fanout, edge, jitter, environmental, and manufacturing-neutral board bounds. They do not select topology, components, support networks, nets, pins, coordinates, layers, routes, providers, models, or repair actions.

cases.prompt: Create a 3.3 V single-ended logic clock output at 8 MHz with 0.01 percent frequency tolerance, 45 to 55 percent duty cycle, no more than 1 ns RMS jitter, startup within 10 ms, at least two logic loads of fanout, rise and fall times below 10 ns into 5 pF to 20 pF, and valid logic levels from minus 20 degC to 70 degC on a board no larger than 38 mm by 28 mm.

Create a 3.0 V to 3.6 V single-ended logic clock output at 100 kHz with 2 percent frequency tolerance, 40 to 60 percent duty cycle, no more than 2 us RMS jitter, startup within 5 ms, at least one logic load of fanout, rise and fall times below 200 ns into 5 pF to 50 pF, and valid logic levels from minus 20 degC to 70 degC on a board no larger than 42 mm by 30 mm.
